aboutInfo.resume: Professional with a solid career in operations, project, and delivery management, with experience in both domestic and international environments, serving large enterprise clients across Latin America, US, Europe, and Asia. I have a strong ability to connect strategy, governance, and execution, leading complex operations with focus on predictability, operational efficiency, profitability, and account expansion. I consistently operate across strategic and financial planning, P&L management, corporate governance, contract management, portfolio management (PMO), and risk and compliance management, in addition to having solid experience in process structuring and continuous improvement, KPI definition and performance monitoring, digital transformation, and new business development. I lead multidisciplinary teams and managers, engage directly in executive-level negotiations, pricing strategy, proposals and budgeting, and deliver corporate training and executive mentoring.

homePageProject.title: Explore My Portfolio
homePageProject.text: I invite you to explore my portfolio of real-world projects, showcasing the clients I have supported through project management and digital transformation consultancy, along with a summary of the key initiatives and outcomes delivered for each.

objectivesText.0: The project aimed to drive enterprise digital transformation through the development of applications on the OutSystems platform, enabling greater process integration, operational refinement, and scalability. The initiative focused on reducing human error, increasing efficiency, and leveraging technology to enhance control, reliability, and standardization across corporate processes
objectivesText.1: The project was designed to deliver a structural and sustainable digital transformation, combining low-code application development on the OutSystems platform with intelligent process automation through RPA. The initiative focused on refining, standardizing, and integrating critical corporate processes, with the goals of significantly reducing manual effort per employee, minimizing human error and rework, increasing data reliability, and integrating operational workflows with corporate platforms — particularly SAP ERP and tools within the Microsoft ecosystem. A key strategic objective was to release operational capacity, enabling the reallocation of professionals to areas with workforce capacity gaps, without compromising business continuity or service quality.
objectivesText.2: The project aimed to deliver a fully integrated, global-scale digital transformation across all company locations worldwide. The initiative focused on technological innovation, process modernization and continuous improvement, and facilitating access to strategic and operational information for business areas, enabling greater efficiency, agility, standardization, and executive-level decision support.

aboutClient.0: Apple is one of the world’s leading technology companies, globally recognized for its innovation, operational excellence, and strong focus on user experience. Operating across multiple regions with highly complex corporate structures, the company maintains rigorous standards for governance, efficiency, and process control throughout its global operations.
aboutClient.1: The client is a global organization with international operations and a presence across multiple regions worldwide, operating in a highly dynamic and competitive corporate environment. Its business is distributed across several locations, supported by complex processes and a strong reliance on technology to sustain operations, decision-making, and long-term growth, requiring robust, secure, and scalable digital solutions.
aboutClient.2: Petrobras is one of the world’s largest integrated energy companies and a global reference in the oil, gas, and energy sectors. With large-scale and highly complex operations, the company operates across the entire value chain — from exploration and production to refining, logistics, distribution, and corporate functions — under strict standards of governance, compliance, financial control, and operational efficiency. This environment requires robust, scalable, and highly integrated technological solutions capable of supporting mission-critical processes and high transaction volumes.

execucao.0: The execution involved the direct leadership of a multidisciplinary team of approximately 20 professionals, with continuous engagement and alignment with client stakeholders. The delivery model emphasized strong governance, demand prioritization, KPI tracking, and executive-level communication. Additionally, Margin Improvement Plan (MIP) initiatives were implemented to enhance financial performance, ensuring cost efficiency, delivery predictability, and alignment between scope, timelines, and quality. Close collaboration with the client enabled fast decision-making and sustained alignment with business objectives.
execucao.1: Project execution involved the direct management of more than 150 professionals, distributed across development, support, business, coordination, and management teams, supported by a strong delivery governance model and continuous engagement with client stakeholders. Regular executive-level reporting to C-suite leadership was conducted, with a focus on performance indicators, risk management, roadmap evolution, and financial results. In parallel, structured Margin Improvement and Performance (MIP) initiatives were implemented, including operating model redesign, resource allocation optimization, productivity improvements, and rigorous cost and scope control. These actions enabled the turnaround of a critical financial scenario, reversing a negative margin of -458% to a positive margin of +2% within six months. The program also included complex integrations with SAP, Excel, Microsoft Office, and other corporate platforms, as well as the design and delivery of a Citizen Development enablement program, empowering client professionals to build, maintain, and evolve solutions independently, strengthening organizational autonomy and digital maturity.
execucao.2: Execution involved the direct management of more than 40 professionals, organized across development, support, business, coordination, and management teams, supported by strong governance and continuous engagement with client stakeholders. Regular executive-level reporting to the C-suite ensured strategic alignment, transparency on risks, progress, and outcomes. The scope also included integrations with corporate systems such as SAP, Excel, and tools within the Microsoft ecosystem, the execution of structured User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles with the client, the development and management of program and project roadmaps, and the strategic allocation of resources, ensuring predictability, quality, and alignment with business objectives.

desafio.0: The primary challenge was to redesign and optimize processes characterized by recurring information gaps and continuous human error, largely driven by manual activities. In parallel, it was necessary to interconnect multiple business processes and functional areas through new applications, ensuring higher accuracy, traceability, and operational consistency within a complex, highly regulated corporate environment.
desafio.1: The primary challenge involved transforming highly manual processes characterized by recurring information gaps, low standardization, and frequent human error into digital workflows that were more accurate, traceable, integrated, and data-driven. In parallel, the project required the interconnection of multiple business processes and functional areas through new applications, the substantial reduction of execution time for critical activities — in some cases achieving gains of up to 25 times faster processing — and the management of large-scale organizational change, while maintaining strict governance, compliance, and financial control within a highly regulated environment.
desafio.2: The primary challenge was to design and orchestrate multiple technology initiatives in a cohesive manner, including data collection and analysis through analytics platforms, process automation, implementation of Artificial Intelligence using Machine Learning and Large Language Models (LLMs), full-stack application development, UX-driven mockup design, and the delivery of Business Intelligence solutions with executive and operational insights. Additionally, the project required the implementation of a robust technology infrastructure, encompassing cybersecurity, networking, hardware and performance monitoring, as well as ensuring the ongoing support and maintenance of applications, guaranteeing stability, security, and scalability within a globally distributed environment.

resultados.0: As a result, more than 20 enterprise applications were delivered across multiple business areas, including Human Resources, Finance, and Audit. The implemented solutions generated approximately 25% improvement in process agility, while achieving a reduction of over 80% in human error, significantly strengthening operational control, reliability, and overall process efficiency.
resultados.1: As a result, more than 20 enterprise applications were delivered and over 450 robots were deployed in production, generating savings of more than 200,000 work hours per month, equivalent to approximately 1,250 full-time employees working eight hours per day throughout an entire month. Over the course of the program, cumulative savings exceeded 2 million work hours, alongside a reduction of more than 50% in human error and substantial gains in operational efficiency. A key highlight was the achievement of over BRL 6 billion in annual savings, driven by the development of just 10 robots for tax-related processes, demonstrating the strategic impact of automation on critical business functions. The initiative became a global reference case, presented at the Automation Anywhere international event in New York, and directly contributed to the expansion of the commercial relationship, opening opportunities for new contracts, additional technologies, and further strategic initiatives, while significantly elevating the organization’s level of digital maturity, governance, and long-term operational sustainability.
resultados.2: As a result, more than 20 projects were successfully delivered across multiple technologies, spanning data, automation, AI, enterprise applications, and infrastructure. Executive and operational dashboards were implemented, significantly improving the speed and quality of strategic decision-making. Dedicated solutions for Human Resources enabled the accelerated sourcing and onboarding of new candidates for open positions. LLM-based solutions allowed real-time retrieval of internal project information, enhancing transparency and operational efficiency. The automation of sales order creation reduced process execution time by over 80%, while WhatsApp integrations enabled associates to access documentation directly through chat interfaces. Process automation delivered monthly savings of more than 80,000 work hours, and the implementation of technologies such as Intune and Xensan enabled real-time, high-accuracy monitoring of installed hardware, significantly strengthening operational control, security, and performance across the company’s technology landscape, among several other strategic and operational gains.
